headline: GTPL Hathway Limited acquires cable television business from ACT Group
sum: GTPL Hathway announced the acquisition of cable television business operations from various companies within the ACT Group, disclosed under SEBI LODR Regulation 30 via NSE filing on 23 June 2026.
detail: GTPL Hathway Limited, a listed cable distribution and broadband operator, has executed an acquisition of cable television business assets from one or more entities within the ACT Group (ACT Fibernet / ACT Telecom ecosystem). The transaction was disclosed under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, indicating materiality. No specific consideration amount, conditions precedent, or regulatory approvals are disclosed in publicly available sources as of 23 June 2026.
